chars.NARRATOR: a slim Moroccan man of 26 with short curly black hair and a short beard, wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie and dark blue jeans
chars.WIFE: a Moroccan woman of 28 with a bright red headscarf tied loosely, wearing a purple satin djellaba, gold hoop earrings, heavy eyeliner

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: 2D cartoon, inside a simple rural Moroccan farmhouse salon with long banquettes and colourful cushions, whitewashed walls, a low round table with a tea tray, warm afternoon light: WIFE sits on the banquette crying loudly with tears running down her cheeks, wiping her eyes with her sleeve, while NARRATOR sits next to her looking surprised and worried

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: 2D cartoon, inside a simple rural Moroccan farmhouse salon with long banquettes and colourful cushions, whitewashed walls, a low round table with a tea tray, warm afternoon light: NARRATOR gives WIFE a short awkward brotherly side hug, patting her shoulder with a stiff careful face, WIFE still sad leaning on his shoulder

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: 2D cartoon, inside a simple rural Moroccan farmhouse salon with long banquettes and colourful cushions, whitewashed walls, a low round table with a tea tray, warm afternoon light: NARRATOR sits facing WIFE and talks to her calmly with open hands, giving advice, WIFE listens and sniffles holding a tissue

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: 2D cartoon, inside a simple rural Moroccan farmhouse salon with long banquettes and colourful cushions, whitewashed walls, a low round table with a tea tray, warm afternoon light: WIFE suddenly smiles flirtatiously and lays her hand on NARRATOR's arm, looking at him with half-closed eyes, NARRATOR glances down at her hand, puzzled

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: 2D cartoon, inside a simple rural Moroccan farmhouse salon with long banquettes and colourful cushions, whitewashed walls, a low round table with a tea tray, warm afternoon light: close shot of NARRATOR frozen in shock with wide eyes and open mouth, sweat drop on his forehead, WIFE smiling slyly beside him

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: 2D cartoon, inside a simple rural Moroccan farmhouse salon with long banquettes and colourful cushions, whitewashed walls, a low round table with a tea tray, warm afternoon light: WIFE leans in closer to NARRATOR, batting her eyelashes and playing with the end of her red headscarf, NARRATOR leans back away from her on the banquette, very uncomfortable

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: 2D cartoon, inside a simple rural Moroccan farmhouse salon with long banquettes and colourful cushions, whitewashed walls, a low round table with a tea tray, warm afternoon light: NARRATOR stands up and steps back with both palms raised in refusal, serious conflicted face, the tea tray behind him

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: 2D cartoon, inside a simple rural Moroccan farmhouse salon with long banquettes and colourful cushions, whitewashed walls, a low round table with a tea tray, warm afternoon light: NARRATOR holds his head with both hands, dizzy and confused, while WIFE sits on the banquette watching him with a calm mysterious smile

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: 2D cartoon, inside a simple rural Moroccan farmhouse salon with long banquettes and colourful cushions, whitewashed walls, a low round table with a tea tray, warm afternoon light: NARRATOR stares at WIFE with narrowed suspicious eyes, WIFE looks back at him with a secretive smile as if about to confess something
